description: This repository's own updates, on top of the shared preset KevinDeBenedetti/renovate-config (schedule, release age, SHA-pinned actions, prek hooks, labels). ignorePaths is config:best-practices' without `**/examples/**`: the examples are copied into other repositories, so their pins move with the workflows' own.

github-actions.description: Also the `uses:` lines of the docs and the examples: their SHA pins are copied into other repositories, so they move with the workflows' own.

customManagers.description: Tool versions pinned as literals inside workflows and composite actions (promtool, yq, terraform, pnpm). The github-actions manager only sees `uses:` refs and container images — a version baked into a download URL or a workflow input default is invisible to it, so it silently rots. The tools the actions download and verify are pinned in .github/actions/install-tool/tools.json instead (next manager).

The tools the composite actions download and verify (actionlint, kubeconform, shellcheck, lychee, gitleaks, claude-code, bats): one entry each in the install-tool action's tools.json, with its datasource and tag format; the action reads it at run time. scripts/update-tool-checksums.py then refreshes the checksums.

GitHub-hosted runner labels written as JSON strings ('"ubuntu-26.04"'): the `runner` input defaults and descriptions of the reusable workflows, and the docs that repeat them. The github-actions manager only reads literal `runs-on` values — never `fromJson(inputs.runner)` — so without this the defaults would stay behind every image bump.
Literal `runs-on: ubuntu-…` labels outside .github/ — the examples copied into other repositories and the docs' snippets — which the github-actions manager does not scan.

packageRules.description: These versions are stored WITHOUT the leading v (the download URL adds it back), while the upstream tags carry it — strip it so comparisons work. Scoped to .github/: prek.toml pins rhysd/actionlint WITH the v. The tools of install-tool's tools.json carry their own extractVersion.

The tools of install-tool's tools.json are downloaded and verified against a SHA-256 (or commit) pinned next to the version: Renovate bumps the version only, so CI fails closed until the pins are refreshed.
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ Pinned checksums: run `scripts/update-tool-checksums.py` on this branch and commit the result (`tools.json` only) — CI fails until then.

packageRules.description: actionlint >= 1.7.12 ships stale metadata for actions/create-github-app-token@v3 (false positives on `client-id`): callers of the actionlint action that do not pass `-ignore create-github-app-token` would break. Bumps need a deliberate approval from the dependency dashboard.
promtool and yq are installed by the same step in ci-prometheus.yml: labelled so they stand out in the preset's single weekly pull request.

A runner image bump moves every label at once — the literal `runs-on` (github-actions manager), the `runner` input defaults and the docs (custom managers above) — and callers get the image of the release they pin: read the announcement before merging the preset's single weekly pull request.
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ New runner image: read its announcement in actions/runner-images (removed tools, changed defaults) before merging.
